headline: Weathered Expanse Contest Sharpens as Callahan's Passage Reopens
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse remains the war's sharpest contest, and its no-man's-land has been swallowed whole: the nine squares there now stand five Warden and four Colonial, with sixty-four base events in the past day and six in the last two hours about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Callahan's Passage, silent on the map board in the previous edition, has reopened at The Crumbling Passage—twenty-three events there in a day and two within the last two hours—though its day's returns, near 10,279 Colonial and 13,075 Warden, are the heaviest of any front. Fisherman's Row holds at three Warden to six Colonial around Eidolo and Black Well. Stlican Shelf's last neutral square has been claimed, leaving four Warden to five Colonial, with Breaker Town the busiest ground. Nevish Line stirs at Grief Mother; Mooring County's fighting has eased about The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk. Of the fifty-three regions reported, only six carry more than one colour, and Colonials hold the rest in the great majority.
